race.comment: KAKODA (10) has gone to a new level this prep and raced with distinction in Highway grade. Placed two back in Highway class, then snagged back from the wide gate with a battling eleventh over 1100m at Randwick. Finds a suitable race and can return to winning form. TRIPLE YES (11) showed plenty of fight first up with a gritty on-pace second over 1000m at Tuncurry. Win record hardly excites and must be kept safe. THIRD BASE (5) dropped in grade when returning to winning form over 900m at  Newcastle. Trained here and has a solid record over this course and distance. Each way. CLIFTON SPRINGS (6) has a host of gear changes for this and gets a better set-up with the good weight drop. Will appreciate the firmer surface.
